name: Frostclutch
tactics: A frostclutch quickly flies into combat and uses frozen grasp against the closest foe. It uses drag to move that foe away from any potential assistance and either freezes it with its chilling touch or uses entomb to put the foe into a block of ice.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

powers.name: Chilling Touch
powers.description: automatically hits a target grabbed by the frostclutch

powers.name: Frozen Grasp
powers.requirements: usable only while the frostclutch does not have a creature grabbed

hit.description: cold damage, and the target is grabbed

powers.name: Entomb
powers.range: Targets a creature grabbed by the frostclutch

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.range: Targets a creature grabbed by the frostclutch

hit.description: cold damage, the grab ends, and the target is entombed in ice (save ends). While entombed, the target takes ongoing 10 cold damage and is stunned. No creature has line of effect to the target.

miss.description: Half damage, the grab ends, and the target is entombed until the end of the frostclutch’s next turn

powers.name: Drag
powers.requirements: usable only while the frostclutch has a creature grabbed

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.targets: Targets a creature grabbed by the frostclutch

effect.description: Targets a creature grabbed by the frostclutch; +22 vs. Fortitude; the frostclutch shifts 3 squares and pulls the grabbed target with it.
